issues.text: After acquiring the write lock, the cache is not rechecked: on cold start, every concurrent request rebuilds the assets manifest on its own.
issues.zh: 取得寫鎖後沒有重新檢查快取：冷啟動時每個並行 request 都會各自重建一次 assets manifest

issues.text: This fixes a data race but ships no concurrency test; the fixed path currently has zero coverage.
issues.zh: 修的是 data race，但沒有附上任何併發測試，被修的路徑目前零覆蓋

issues.text: In Dev mode, a read lock is acquired for nothing.
issues.zh: Dev 模式下白取一次讀鎖

issues.text: `return entryPointAssetsCache, err` could just return `result` directly.
issues.zh: return entryPointAssetsCache, err 可以直接回 result

open_questions.text: In Dev mode every request holds the exclusive lock while opening a file and JSON-decoding it — is this serialization cost acceptable for the dev server?
open_questions.zh: Dev 模式下每個 request 都握著獨占鎖做一次開檔加 JSON decode，這個序列化成本對 dev server 可以接受嗎？

open_questions.text: Is there a plan to enable the hardcoded `cdn := ""` line? If so, is making an outbound HTTP request while holding the exclusive lock acceptable?
open_questions.zh: webassets.go:54 那行寫死的 cdn := "" 是否有啟用計畫？若有，在獨占鎖內對外做 HTTP 請求可以接受嗎？

open_questions.text: Might grafana-enterprise or other entry points outside this repo call GetWebAssets once to warm the cache before serving traffic begins?
open_questions.zh: grafana-enterprise 或其他不在本 repo 的進入點，會不會在開始服務流量前先呼叫一次 GetWebAssets 把快取暖起來？
